mapper.insert: insert into litemall_order_status (order_id, old_status, new_status, change_type, change_message, change_time, operator, add_time, update_time, deleted) values (#{orderId}, #{oldStatus}, #{newStatus}, #{changeType}, #{changeMessage}, #{changeTime}, #{operator}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: select id, order_id, old_status, new_status, change_type, change_message, change_time, operator, add_time, update_time, deleted from litemall_order_status where order_id = #{orderId} and deleted = 0 order by change_time asc, id asc
select count(*) from litemall_order_status where order_id = #{orderId} and deleted = 0
